==Description==
The '''Bomber Elf''' was the fourth enemy to appear in [[Krampus Frosthold]] as part of the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]]. Unlike previous enemies that appeared in the first stage, it did not appear in large hordes. However, it had faster speed and higher health than all enemies that appeared before it. Additionally, its ability, ''Explosive Delivery'', made it dangerous against unprepared defenses.

==Appearance==
The '''Bomber Elf''' was a pale-skinned humanoid. It had full orange garb with white fur, with a hazard sign on its Christmas hat. It had a black belt and shoes.

It carried a giant present wrapped with black shaded diamond pattern wrapping paper and an orange ribbon holding it together. A lit fuse protruded from the top of the present.

==Strategy==
*It is recommended to place towers apart in order to avoid them all getting stunned by the '''Bomber Elf's''' ability.
*Towers that cannot get stunned, like the [[Ace Pilot]] or the [[Pursuit]], can be very useful at clearing out enemies when other towers are stunned.

==Trivia==
*Weirdly, [[Santa]]'s dialogue for the '''Bomber Elf''' appears on Wave 5, which is two waves earlier than the '''Bomber Elf's''' actual debut.
